Perform comprehensive black-box reconnaissance and attack-surface mapping of http://host.docker.internal:5199 (the ONLY in-scope target; do not touch anything else).

Objectives:
1. Confirm reachability (curl -i), identify server/framework/technology fingerprints from headers, cookies, error pages, favicon hashes.
2. Map ALL reachable routes/endpoints: crawl with katana/gospider (bounded depth ~3, duration ~3 min max), probe common paths (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, .env, .git, /api/, /admin, /login, /register, /dashboard, swagger/openapi docs like /docs /openapi.json /swagger.json /api-docs).
3. Discover forms, parameters, client-side JS hints about API structure (fetch/XHR calls in JS bundles — extract endpoint URLs).

5. Enumerate HTTP methods accepted on key endpoints (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS), note status codes and response sizes for baseline comparison.
6. Check for exposed debug endpoints, health checks, metrics, admin panels, file listings, directory indexes.
7. Save your full findings to a note via create_note (category=wiki) listing every discovered endpoint with method, params, auth requirement, and response signature so downstream agents can build on it.

Constraints: keep scans bounded (no unbounded brute force), do NOT send exploit payloads yet — mapping only. Record coverage with record_coverage for surfaces you mapped. Report back a concise summary of the attack surface when done.
